title: My Life & My Cashflow Affirmations - June 2026
description: Daily affirmations by Chinedum Ilechukwu - Celebrating 1 Year of Wonders

affirmations.title: I See Victory in All Situations
affirmations.content:
I affirm that I have victory in this life and I triumph in whatever situations I get into. Victory is in my DNA. I'm like the wind that blows from where it wills — no one can cage me. No force can quench me. Nothing in my world suggests defeat because I don't get defeated.

I look left I see victory. I look right I see victory. I look backwards I see victory. I look up I see victory. I look at my accounts I see victory. I look at my health and ministry I see victory everywhere. So much victory, absolute victory.

My riches is scary. Lack, demons, diseases and death are afraid of me because I'm eternal life made manifest on earth today. Hallelujah. Glory Glory Glory. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Incorruptible Foundation
affirmations.content:
Adamic foundation is a collapsed and corrupt system. Our Lord Jesus is the foundation of the new covenant. Hallelujah. The incorruptible foundation. I'm found in Christ the foundation of the new order and the chief corner stone of the Last house.

He was born without corruption and being born of him, I have an incorruptible life. My foundation is Holy and without blame.

No ancestral foundation can attack or affect my prosperity. No genetic disease can afflict my body. I'm the body of Christ on earth today. I hail from God and have overcome this world, for greater is He that is in me than He that is in this world. Glorrrrrrrrrrrrrrry. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Rooted in Christ
affirmations.content:
My new birth is not earthly but heavenly. I'm born not of blood, not of flesh, not of the will of man but by the will of God. God is my Father and that's the end of the matter.

Being born of God, I have overcome this world. My root is Christ and nothing shall cut me off from Christ.

Nothing shall separate me from the love of God. For I am persuaded, the bible says, that neither death, nor life, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present nor things past, nor depth nor height shall be able to separate me from the love which I have in Christ Jesus my Lord.

What a root?? Incorruptible, blameless, boundless, indestructible and deathless. Hallelujah. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Heaven Is Rich
affirmations.content:
Heaven is rich that even the streets are paved in gold. So poverty is unrighteousness and an illegality in our Kingdom.

I am the evidence that Jesus is no longer in the grave. He has risen and baptised me with abounding grace to live the rich life of heaven on earth here.

The heaven where we are going is full of riches and every good thing. So I refuse to lack any good thing and affirm, that I'm the evidence here that heaven is rich. And being the citizen of heaven on earth today, I have refused to live in lack because I'm trained to resist lack with all the religious gimmicks it comes with.

I'm the evidence of the empty tomb and boldly affirm, that the abounding grace that empty tomb brought will never be in vain in my finances. A million times no. Hallelujah. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: It's Rain of Cashflow
affirmations.content:
It's my time for the rain of cash. I look up and receive. Nothing is stopping me.

For I will fill this temple with glory, says the Lord. The silver is mine, the gold is mine. And the glory of this latter house shall surpass that of the former. The great wealth transfer is coming. Lord I believe, I believe and I'm ready to receive.

I make myself a partaker of this coming wealth transfer as I give crazyingly to the work of God. I affirm that God will find me trustworthy to be used of Him in this last days.

Yes I will lay up cash as dust by the Power of the Spirit because the assignment is large. Hallelujah, Hallelujah. Glory Glory Glory to God. Folks, it's rain of cashflow!! Worship and thank Him.

affirmations.title: I Take Right Decisions
affirmations.content:
I affirm that in whatsoever I do and wherever I go I'm taking the right decisions. I refuse to walk in confusion. I'm doing the right thing as the wisdom of God is working exceptionally in my mind. I'm not the kind that stutter or struggle. No no, no way.

I'm a repository of divine wisdom and I function in the wisdom of God.

I'm prudent in my financial decisions. I'm excellent in my choice of meals. I eat the right thing and I speak the right words at every moment there's need. Yea, I talk the right words needed for the very hour. I'm distinguished among my peers because this divine wisdom I walk in has put me in a pure class uncommon among folks.

It has guaranteed my sound health and perfect security right in the midst of tight situations. Hallelujah. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Addicted to Salvation of Souls
affirmations.content:
I see souls, souls, souls, many souls, so many many many souls coming in by the Power of the Holy Spirit. There's no stopping them for the bible says, '...and people from all nations shall say, come let us go to the house of God of Jacob and He will teach us His ways and we shall walk in His path. For out of Zion shall go forth the instructions on how to stay alive and from Jerusalem the Word of God.'

Thank God I'm part of this coming great harvest of souls that will shake the entire nations of the world. I'm addicted to salvation of souls, so I'm committed to soul winning in season and out of season. Soulwinning is my addiction and no wonder I'm so set for what God is about to do all over the nations of the world. Hallelujah. Glory Glory Glory. Please pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Powers Behind Sickness Are Destroyed
affirmations.content:
I affirm that every power behind sickness, disease and infirmities are completely destroyed out of my life. I live above them night and day and in all seasons. Hallelujah.

Powers behind sickness and diseases, you are completely destroyed and you got no power over me. I'm a Spirit and I live the Spirit life. My life is in God's Word and not in my blood. So nothing can contaminate or infect my blood. Not today, not tomorrow and not forever. Glory to God. Please pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Forces of Evil Can't Stop Me
affirmations.content:
You won't stop me. I address you, all forces of evil; you won't stop me. Delay, failure, denials, frustrations, loss of memory, exam fever, low income, poor eye sight, chest pain, infections, fear of failure, fear of attack, fear of sickness, fear of accident, fear of death — I have overcome you all.

Right now, I live victoriously and gloriously without fear, doubt or unbelief.

My life is a reflection of honor, abundance, divine health, safety, riches and comfort. This is my heritage in Christ. Hallelujah. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: A Mighty Revival Is Coming
affirmations.content:
I'm getting ready for the mighty and greatest Revival this world has never seen. So many many souls are getting saved. Both small and great. I'm so ready. Bring it on, I'm up for it. The hour has come and nothing is stopping it.

Three things will characterise this mighty Revival: Unprecedented cashflow into the Church, unbelievable salvation of souls, and strange signs, wonders, miracles and unusual healings will be common among believers all over the world. Lord I believe!!!

It's initiated by the Spirit, powered by the Spirit and delivered by the Spirit. That even the worst of folks are coming to the Lord. Glory to God.

For it shall come to pass, the bible says, that whosoever shall call upon the Name of the Lord shall be saved. Are you ready? Bring it on, I'm so ready for it. Glorrrrrrrrry. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Shut Up Satan
affirmations.content:
Shut up devils, you don't whisper your lies into my ears about my life and my cashflow. Shut up, you don't talk to me about my health. You know I don't get sick. I'm immortal. Eternity runs in my blood and my entire being is inundated with the glory of God. You don't tell me about my cashflow, because I operate a dimension of grace you can't handle.

Rich life is my heritage in this world and cashflow is my addiction and you can't stop it. My cash is incalculable and is growing so rapidly and beyond every limitations.

Shut up, shut up demons, your lot is permanently under my feet. I'm not giving away even the slightest chance. I got the name of Jesus and you're vehemently resisted by the Power of this name. This is the way it is. Hallelujah. Glorrrrrrry. Come on, pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: I Know God
affirmations.content:
I declare that I know God, nobody can take me for a ride. I know God, no one can intimidate me. I know God, no one can make me feel I'm stranded. I know God, no one can make me feel I walk alone. No way, not in this world. For God is with me and no one can be against me.

No one can hinder my access to the best things of life. I know God, no one will frustrate my walk with Him. I know God, I'm sure of hitting the mark no matter the storm. I know God, I affirm I will outlive every one who is against my life. I know God, so aging and death has no ability over me. And I affirm that being born in the last house, I'm anointed to outlive death. Glory to God. Please Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: If God Can't Give It
affirmations.content:
I affirm that whatever God can't give me I don't need it. If God can't give me you, I don't need you. If God won't give it I let it.

The bible says, all that my heavenly Father has given me shall come to me. And of all that my Father has given me I shall lose nothing but raise them on the last day.

I affirm that if God can't give it, I don't need it. If God can't move it, it's not a requirement. Everything is obedient to me, for whithersoever I goeth I prosper, the bible says.

I call forth all that the Father has given me, come to me now!!! Every man, woman, boy or girl keep coming to me. Your life is secured here by the Power of God. Glory Glory Glory hallelujah. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Called to Turn Many to Righteousness
affirmations.content:
I affirm that I'm called to turn many to righteousness. So nobody will resist my message. White, black or blonde. Educated or uneducated. Rich or poor. Wicked or good. Religious or heathen. I'm anointed to destroy yokes.

I affirm that they are responding to the Message of life as I preach. I have a mouth and My Life And My Cashflow Affirmations which none can resist or contradict. And I'm set to carry the Message of life to nations of the earth. From Europe to America, from America to South America, from South America to Australia, from Australia to Asia, from Asia to Africa and from Africa to Oceania.

I affirm that the Message of life is growing and prevailing in all the nations. It's having a free course, hallelujah. Please pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Satan You're Losing Out
affirmations.content:
Satan, I affirm that you're losing out among nations because of me. You're losing the treasures. You're losing the people, bond or free. You're losing the estates. You're losing the territorial waters. You're losing the continental shelfs. You're losing the reserves. I'm on my way and the Message of life has gone forth into the nations.

For even the prey of the mighty shall be taken and the lawful captive of the terrible shall be delivered. You can't stand the fire satan, even your lawful captives will be set free. We are on our way, 'for a saviour shall come from Zion,' the bible says.

Get lost satan over the nations. Get lost!! Shout, glorrrrrrrrrrrrrrry and Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Treasures of Nations Shall Come
affirmations.content:
The Scriptures can never be broken, the bible declares that in the last days the treasures of nations shall come. This is the last days and they're coming to us in abundance.

I command the dollars to come to me, I command euros, I command pounds, I command rands, I command yens to come to me in multiple millions. Keep coming from different nations and countries. I affirm that treasures of nations are coming to me as I call it forth, in multiple millions per minutes.

Not by might nor by power but by the Spirit of the Lord. Just as the Prophets foretold. Glorrrrrrrrrrrrrrry. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: My Desires Are Coming Through
affirmations.content:
I affirm that whatsoever I desire in this life is coming through. My deals are coming through. My plans are coming through. My efforts, dreams and visions are coming through.

There's no delay in my world, that evil got no chance with me. No delay in my cashflow, no delay in my new jobs, no delay in my marriage, no delay in my child birth, no delay in my riches, no delay in my businesses, no delay in my investments.

I'm having more than enough. My marriage is a blessing, my children surrounds my table and I will see my children's children. Hallelujah. Glory to God. Please pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Enriched by His Grace
affirmations.content:
I affirm that I'm enriched in all things by the grace of my Lord Jesus Christ. I will never be disadvantaged in this life. I'm so favoured that no-one and nothing can neglect or disqualify me. I'm thankful and won't stop thanking God for His choice of me. I got the utterance, the perfect diction and sound knowledge. No good thing eludes me in this world. Hallelujah.

For 'I thank my God always on your behalf, for the grace of God which is given you by Jesus Christ; That in every thing ye are enriched by him, in all utterance, and in all knowledge.'

I'm enjoying this and nothing is stopping it. Glorrrrrrrrrrrrrrry. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: I'm Not Lacking in Any Gift
affirmations.content:
I declare that I'm not lacking in any gift by the Power of God. I have abundance of gifts of the Spirit and I edify the body with my giftings and talents. I refuse to be unproductive nor lack in any gift. I'm the light of the world and a super inspiration to the Church. Using my gifts I have become a great encouragement and source of hope to the Church. A joy of many generations and constant happiness to the brethren.

The bible says, '... even as the testimony of Christ was confirmed in me, so that I come behind in no gift; waiting for the coming of our Lord Jesus Christ: Who shall also confirm me unto the end, that I may be blameless in the day of our Lord Jesus Christ.'

Blessed be God forever. Amen. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: I Will Be What God Called Me to Be
affirmations.content:
Apostle Paul, in his letter to the Colossians sent a specific instruction to Archippus, '...Take heed to the ministry which thou hast received in the Lord, that thou fulfill it.'

If the man didn't have the responsibility to fulfil the ministry that God committed to him, Paul wouldn't have instructed him to see to it that he fulfilled it. This also meant it was possible for him not to fulfil it.

I affirm that my mind is made up not only to fulfil my Ministry but become everything that God has destined me to be. I will do all that He's predestined me to do, and I will walk in His preordained pathways. Nothing can stop me. Hallelujah. Please pray in the Holy Ghost.

affirmations.title: We Will Shake This World
affirmations.content:
We will shake this world by the Power of the Holy Ghost. You asked how? Yes we will. We are the next biggest thing that will happen in this world before the rapture folks.

Thank God I'm part of this thing. I affirm that I'm so relevant in this Move of the Spirit and nothing and no one can take my place.

The bible says: 'For ye see your calling, brethren, how that not many wise men after the flesh, not many mighty, not many noble, are called: But God hath chosen the foolish things of the world to confound the wise; and God hath chosen the weak things of the world to confound the things which are mighty; And base things of the world, and things which are despised, hath God chosen, yea, and things which are not, to bring to nought things that are: That no flesh should glory in his presence.'

Glorrrrrrrrrrrrrrry. Please Pray in the Spirit!

affirmations.title: The World Awaits Me
affirmations.content:
The world has been waiting but thank God I'm here. We are here. The last generation. The glory generation. The generation of Christ. The generation that will usher in Christ. Hallelujah.

I'm glad I'm part of this generation. The generation that don't die until they see the Kingdom of God come in power and great glory.

Nothing will escape us. Immeasurable and incalculable riches is mine. Incredible demonstration of the Spirit and power and a kind of mighty harvest of souls such as the world has never seen before.

I'm so set for the unprecedented Manifestations, having subdued sickness and infirmities, and destroyed death with all its gripping effects.

'For the earnest expectation of the creation eagerly waits for the revealing of the sons of God,' the Bible says. Thank you Jesus. What a life, what a time and what a race we are. Please pray in the Spirit!

affirmations.title: Impossibilities Respond to Me
affirmations.content:
I affirm that nothing is impossible with me. My life and My cashflow affirmations in my mouth is living and powerful, and sharper than any two-edged sword, piercing even to the division of soul and spirit, and of joints and marrow, and is a discerner of the thoughts and intents of the heart.

No situation however impossible can resist my words. For I have received a mouth and a wisdom which none of my adversaries will be able to resist or gainsay. Blessed be God forever.

So as I affirm, demons flee, mountains quake, delay melts, cash flows and blessings abound. This is what it is. Oh hallelujah. Pray in the Spirit!

affirmations.title: Cut It Off
affirmations.content:
I affirm that whatever it's not in God's plan for my life and cashflow is cut off now in Jesus Name.

I cut off delay. I cut off disappointment. I cut off failure. I cut off disease and infirmities. I cut off every witchcraft. I cut off attack. I cut off accident. I cut off aging. I cut off fear and intimidation. I cut off lack. I cut off low cashflow. I cut off incessant postponement. I cut off stories. I cut off struggles. I cut off unfruitfulness. I cut off unproductivity. I cut off poor results. I cut off fake and wrong guys. I cut off every friendly enemy. I cut off unreasonable men. I cut off jealousy. I cut off resentment. I cut off hatred. I cut off every satanic projection and I cut off death.

And you're cut off completely and comprehensively now and forever in the Name of Jesus. Glorrrrrrrrrrrrrrry. Rejoice in the Lord!

affirmations.title: Lifted Above Satanic Attack
affirmations.content:
I affirm that I don't operate in this earthly realm of life. I operate in the heavenly realm where no satanic schemes or attack can get to. I live in heaven but work here on earth.

No radar of satan and his evil world can pick me. I live above their instructions. I live above their condemnation. I live above their dominion and authorities. Above their projections, plots, strategies and conspiracy.

I affirm that God raised me from the dead with Christ and seated me at His right hand in the heavenly places, far above all principality and power and might and dominion, and every name that is named, not only in this age but also in that which is to come. This is my realm of life now. Glory to God. Pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: God Loves Me
affirmations.content:
I affirm that God loves me beyond me and without me. His love for me is so perfect and never dependent on what I could do or could not do. He knows my capacity and understands my abilities. He knows my strengths and weakness. He knows what I can do and what I can't do but still loves me. His love for me is sublime and has reached its elastic limit. Oh halleluia. He has loved me to the end. I affirm that I have received this love and is so fulfilling and so humbling. Glory to God.

'But God, who is rich in mercy, because of His great love with which He loves me, even when I was dead in trespasses, made me alive together with Christ (by grace I have been saved), and raised me up together, and made me sit together in the heavenly places in Christ Jesus,' the bible says.

Oh blessed be God forever more. Hallelujah. Please worship and thank Him.

affirmations.title: He Touched Me
affirmations.content:
God touched me and His touch has made me whole. I affirm that He has brought wholeness into my soul and has brought completion into my being. I know it and so I affirm it.

It does not matter what I see or feel, I proclaim that I'm made whole. So I refuse to feel any discomfort or pain in any part of my body. I refuse to bow to what my physical eyes see. I'm standing on what I know. He has made me whole and I'm whole completely and comprehensively.

Right now, the very health of God is activated in my body and no disease or infirmity can ever afflict me. No way, not in this world. Hallelujah. Thank you Jesus. Please pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Glorified
affirmations.content:
I'm not the kind that live in fear, guilt, inferiority or any sense of condemnation. I'm conscious of my heavenly citizenship.

In our Kingdom, there is no one weak person there. In our Kingdom there is no condemned person there. In our Kingdom there is no one poor. It's a holy race with very special people. This is the reason we reign victoriously in this world through the One Jesus Christ.

So I'm foreknew. I'm predestined to conform to that very image of Jesus. I'm called. I'm Justified and I'm glorified.

With me, satan and all his darkest kingdoms got no chance. Hahaha. Heeeeeeeey. Shout Gloryyyyy!!

affirmations.title: No to Empty Life
affirmations.content:
I say No to empty life. This is the life I got from my ancestors, good but corruptible because it was born in corruption.

The empty life is prone and susceptible to fear, failure, low life, poor life, average life, accident, slow and defeated life. It is subject to timidity, frustration, disease, infirmities and death. I have refused to live that consciousness.

I live the consciousness of my new life in Christ — The Spirit life. Impregnable to attack, to failure, to poor life, disease, infirmities and death. This is the gospel brothers and sisters, 'that God has given to us His very life and this life is in His Son, whoever has the Son has life and whoever does not have the Son does not have life.' Hallelujah.

I affirm boldly that I have the life of God in every fibre of my being today and this has put me above every negativity of life and all authorities of the devil. Gloryyyyyyyyyyyyyyyyy. Please pray in the Spirit.

affirmations.title: Rooted Out
affirmations.content:
I affirm that whatever thing my heavenly Father has not planted shall be uprooted. They're rooted out. They're illegalities. They're enemies of righteousness. They're disadvantages. They're accursed. They're abhorrence. They're unwanted. Never needed nor will ever be needed in my new world.

I'm up for the best and excellent life. So in the Name of Jesus, I consciously root out low life and empty baskets and my accounts overflow. I'm a money magnate and not settling for mediocrity or decorated poor life.

I root them out under whatever guise, whether they're spirits, human, objects or subjects. They are rooted out. They got no place in me. No way, absolutely unacceptable. Come on, let's Pray in the Holy Ghost.
